description: How the element column is made for each planned kind and form (D67, Q1). carrier_plan@1 draws kind and form per row, while synth_identifier draws its own perturbation and delimiter style, so one synth_identifier step cannot follow the plan. The route, with no code change, is recipe.json's steps: one synth_identifier step per (perturbation, delimiter style) with its own output_prefix and seed (by_kind x the four styles style_by_form needs: 20 steps; wrong_length uses synth_identifier@1.1.0 with wrong_length_layout 'style', since @1 lays a wrong-length value out undelimited whatever the style), then one rule_label step that copies, per row, the column matching the row's kind and form into 'element' (decoy kinds get null and take the rule set's decoy lists in insert_element@1). Proved through a real local build (backend/tests/integration/behaviour/test_ssn_pilot_elements.py, 1,500 plan rows, every one of the 45 non-decoy cells built): every element is its kind and its form, except the known_gaps below. All values are synthetic: valid ones are drawn by synth_identifier from a seeded generator over the issuable ranges (area 001-899 except 666, group 01-99, serial 0001-9999), not taken from any person; since 2011 any such number may be issued, so a synthetic valid value can coincide with a real one by chance, which is why the pilot is private_only and no valid value except the published voided wallet-card number appears in a public file. Minimal pairs (ENH-006 D89) are made from these elements after insert_element@1: see pairs.

wrong_length.note: synth_identifier@1.1.0, wrong_length_layout 'style': the value is laid out in the form's delimiter style, the last group taking the difference (123-45-67890, 123.45.678), so it never holds a well-formed value

bad_check.note: ssn_us has no check digit: bad_check is the never-issued ranges (area 000, 666, 900-999, the advertising range, group 00, serial 0000)

style_note: Renderings normalise back to the element exactly (element_recovered): spaced, split_lines, spelled and mixed_words recover only a value with no delimiters, prose only a dash-delimited one.

pairs.decision: ENH-006 D89 (operator, 2026-10-30): about 70% of each behaviour's training rows are minimal pairs, 30% free-form; D91: probes train and are judged on deployed_truth.
pairs.operator: slot_siblings@1.1.0 (recipe.json), code-made: the carrier's text with only [ins_start, ins_end) replaced; no judge, no extra generation. Each sibling's element column holds what its span holds (1.1.0): null for empty and for a decoy (as on a decoy carrier; decoy_id names it), the masked value; the carrier keeps its own
pairs.carriers: kind pos, element present, genre and generator not held out

variants.empty: nothing in the slot; element_recovered false, so disclosure and deployed_truth are false
variants.decoy:lookalike: a value from the rule set's lookalike list (phone, date, ZIP+4, order id), rendered by the carrier's form; kind lookalike, labels false
variants.decoy:naming_no_value: a placeholder from the rule set's naming_no_value list; kind naming_no_value, labels false
variants.vetoed:masked_value: the masked value in the row's delimiter style (e_masked_sibling, from the e_masked_* columns), rendered by the form; kind masked; disclosure follows framing (D12), deployed_truth is false where the rules see the digits (the masked_value veto) and true in a rendering form

pairs.label_flips: Only a pos carrier framed own_identifier or someones_identifier is positive; its empty and decoy siblings flip both labels, its masked sibling flips deployed_truth in a digits form. Pairs of a pos carrier framed otherwise keep the negative label on both sides (the value alone is not a disclosure).
pairs.not_used: rendering variants: a rendering of a valid value keeps both labels (same-label augmentation, not a contrast), and the plan already draws renderings as forms
pairs.measured: local build, 1,500 plan rows, fake carriers (one sentence): 2,805 training rows, 70.8% paired, 33.9% in label-flipping pairs on deployed_truth, 30.1% on disclosure; 397 siblings of each variant
